name: NYU Tisch School of the Arts
known: Founded on 17 August 1965 as the School of the Arts at New York University, to give "conservatory training in theater and film in the context of a research university" (Wikipedia).

name: Neue Galerie New York
known: Founded by art dealer Serge Sabarsky and collector Ronald Lauder, who met in 1967.
Founder Ronald Lauder was the target of pro-Palestine protests at MoMA (2021, Nov 2024).

name: New York Academy of Art
known: Stuart Pivar is credited as primary founder and Andy Warhol as a key founder and funder (Wikipedia).

name: Noguchi Museum
known: Named for its founder, the sculptor Isamu Noguchi, who bought a former photogravure plant and gas station across the street from his studio in 1974 (Wikipedia).

name: Renee & Chaim Gross Foundation
known: Greater Hudson Heritage Network, with the State Council on the Arts, awarded a $7,500 conservation grant (2 December 2022); the page says the Robert David Lion Gardiner Foundation provides half the funding for such grants in New York City and Nassau and Suffolk counties.

name: School of Visual Arts
known: Ross, MFA Art Practice chair, answered Epstein's 2009 proposal of a "statutory" exhibition of "girls and boys ages 14 - 25" with "You are incredible."

name: SculptureCenter
known: Board officers: Helen Warwick (chair), Anicka Yi (president), Justin Beal and Eleanor Heyman Propp (vice chairs), Andreas Waldburg-Wolfegg (treasurer) and Michael Quinn (secretary).
Director: Sohrab Mohebbi (sculpture-center.org).

name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
known: Mariët Westermann became director in June 2024.
Tomilson Hill has chaired the board since 2021 (Wikipedia;

name: Swiss Institute
known: Directors: Ziba Ardalan de Weck (1987 to 1992), Carin Kuoni, Annette Schindler, Marc-Olivier Wahler, Gianni Jetzer, Simon Castets (2013 to 2021) and Stefanie Hessler (2022 to the present).
Board chairs: Fabienne Abrecht (2002 to 2016) and Maja Hoffmann (2016 to the present) (Wikipedia).
The board chair Maja Hoffmann's LUMA Foundation appears as a partner in 2008 to 2010 and again in 2025 and 2026 (stated by the space).
The director's pay was $209,156 in 2025.

name: The Drawing Center
known: Founded in SoHo in 1977 (Wikipedia names former MoMA assistant curator Martha Beck as founder).
Executive director Laura Hoptman, a former MoMA curator, since 2018 (Wikipedia).

name: The Kitchen
known: Legacy Russell is executive director and chief curator.
Robert Soros is listed as chairperson (the Kitchen's About page).

name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
known: About 1.5 million works in 17 curatorial departments. 5,727,258 visits in fiscal 2025 (Wikipedia).

name: Chrysler Museum of Art
known: Chrysler Jr., son of the founder of the Chrysler Corporation.

name: MASS MoCA
known: Directors: Joe Thompson (1999 to 2021), then Kristy Edmunds.
